tagline: Delivering distinctive expertise and differentiated technology to support national security
hero_kpi_rationale: CACI invests in differentiated technologies including AI to meet critical national security needs, positioning AI as a strategic enabler in its technology offerings.

kpis.name: Advanced data platforms augmented by AI
kpis.explanation: Use of AI in data platforms and applications to enhance national security capabilities.
kpis.description: CACI develops advanced technology platforms integrating AI, particularly in intelligence and cybersecurity.
kpis.signal: AI integrated into key technology solutions

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total company revenue for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Revenue increased by 12.6% driven by 7.2% organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin improved due to effective cost management and strong demand for differentiated services.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin after direct costs.
kpis.description: Calculated as (Revenue - Direct Costs) / Revenue = (8,627.8 - 5,835.6) / 8,627.8 = 32.4%; confirmed in 10-K: direct costs represent 67.6% of revenue in FY2025.

kpis.name: R&D Investment
kpis.explanation: Investments in research and development for differentiated technologies.
kpis.description: CACI invests ahead of customer needs to develop differentiated technologies, particularly in AI and cybersecurity.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 8.65 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 3.34 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.11 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Defense Department Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue generated from the U.S. Department of Defense.
kpis.description: The DoD represents three-quarters of revenue, highlighting strategic dependence on this customer.

kpis.name: Federal Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue from the U.S. federal government.
kpis.description: Nearly 96% of revenue comes from the U.S. federal government, representing a concentrated risk.
kpis.signal: High exposure to political and budgetary risk

risks.title: Contract Loss
risks.summary: Loss of contracts with the federal government could have a significant impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: The company generates 95.7% of its revenue from contracts with the federal government. Loss of contracts could have a material and adverse effect on its business, prospects, financial condition, and operating results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Government Regulations
risks.summary: Changes in government regulations could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in federal government procurement practices or billing rules could harm the company's operating results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition in the sector could have a negative impact on the company's revenue.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive environment where firms compete for contracts. Increased competition could reduce the company's revenue. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: National Security Dependence
risks.summary: The company's dependence on national security could make it vulnerable to changes in national security priorities.
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on national security-related contracts. Changes in national security priorities could impact the company's business. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Subcontracting Issues
risks.summary: Subcontracting problems could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on subcontractors to execute certain contracts. Subcontracting issues could negatively impact the company's business. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Collection Risks
risks.summary: Collection difficulties could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on receivables collection to generate cash flow. Collection difficulties could negatively impact the company's business. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Budgetary Priority Changes
risks.summary: Changes in budgetary priorities could have a negative impact on the company's business.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in federal government budgetary priorities could impact the company's business. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: CACI positions AI as a key strategic technology. The 10-K explicitly mentions 'advanced data platforms and applications augmented by Artificial Intelligence (AI)' as a core component of its differentiated technology offerings for national security needs.
